name: OS1 Memory Vault
summary: Persistent cross-session memory: OpenClaw builtin backend (SQLite, hybrid keyword+vector) + memory-wiki Obsidian vault + nightly Dreaming consolidation.

retention.dailyNotes: evergreen files (MEMORY.md) never decayed; dated notes consolidated by Dreaming
retention.exportPolicy: private memory is never exported to the marketplace repo

autoRefresh.runs: openclaw memory index -> wiki bridge import -> wiki compile

notes: The memory/plugins config lives in agent-gateway/config.template.json. This component creates the vault dirs, initializes the Obsidian wiki (openclaw wiki init), and installs a systemd timer (os1-wiki-refresh.timer) that re-indexes and recompiles the vault every 15 min so it grows as memory grows.
